question: How does reflection on the fear of existence arise in the heart?
premises: Fear of worldly existence can produce a touch or contact in the heart.
From that contact, reflection on the fear of existence can arise.
This manifest reflection ultimately occurs through the descent of power.
inference: Even a fear-born touch in the heart becomes a manifest reflection on existential fear because it is activated by the descent of power.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of ādrava as touch, melting, or agitation is context-dependent.
plain_english: Even from a touch born of fear of worldly existence, a reflection on the fear of existence arises and becomes manifest in the heart through the descent of power.
